name: prisma
description: The Prisma 8 agent skill for Claude Code

plugins.name: prisma
plugins.description: Teaches coding agents how to work with Prisma 8: edit the data contract, emit artefacts, plan and apply migrations, and write typed db.orm / db.sql queries. Use when working with @prisma/orm-postgres, @prisma/orm-sqlite, or @prisma/orm-mongo — not Prisma ORM 7 or earlier. After a version mismatch, run prisma skills sync and continue from the synced project skill under .claude/skills/prisma-8 (or .agents/skills/prisma-8, .cursor/skills/prisma-8, .windsurf/skills/prisma-8) and its references — not this plugin copy.
